description: nMiti Panchak receipt corpus - golden fixtures (R10.1 ritual layer 2, HYA-441). Live-crawled 2026-11-08. Window receipts: Swarnsiddhi's 2026 Panchak table (13 windows, IST printed; NPT = IST + 15 min exactly; their page states 'Panchak is the Moon's position, not a local sunrise') and PanchangBodh's independent 2026 table (13 windows, New Delhi = IST clock). Rule receipts: BhaktiBharat's Panchak festival page (current window, past/next date lists, the five-nakshatra span, the five prohibited activities). The panchak END is the Moon's 360 deg sidereal crossing - the Revati-to-Ashwini nakshatra boundary the locked lunar corpora already gate; the Oct/Nov/Dec windows carry those corpus pins plus their full internal segment chains.

swarnsiddhi.name: Swarnsiddhi Panchak 2026
swarnsiddhi.conventions: 13 rows; IST printed, NPT = IST + 15 min. Row date = the day the window begins. Kind column: typed for Sunday-Tuesday, Friday and Saturday begins; the Wednesday/Thursday rows print '-' (no type - see the naming collision caveat). Rule statement: 'from the second half of Dhanishta to the end of Revati'; 'the instants are the same everywhere in India'.

panchangbodh.name: PanchangBodh Panchak Yoga 2026 (New Delhi)
panchangbodh.conventions: 13 windows, New Delhi local = IST clock, NPT = IST + 15 min. Type column: Madhyam for Wed/Thu begins (their own table documents the weekday mapping). Their ephemeris disagrees with Swarnsiddhi by 16-111 min per boundary (independent computation, coarser theory); their Dec window begins 00:12 IST Dec 15 - past NPT midnight - so their type column prints Agni (see the Dec knife-edge caveat).

bb_festival.name: BhaktiBharat festival page - Panchak
bb_festival.conventions: Current window: begins Tuesday Nov 17 2026 3:30 PM, ends Sunday Nov 22 2026 5:54 AM IST (= 15:45 / 06:09 NPT). Past dates (begins-days): Oct 21, Sep 23, Aug 27, Jul 4, Jun 6, May 10, Apr 13, Mar 16, Feb 17, Jan 21 (2026), Dec 24 2025, and a printed '3 January 2025' row (a source data quirk: no Panchak begins on Jan 3 of either year; the sidereal month puts the next begin at Jan 21 - recorded as printed, never gated). Their 2026 past list skips the Jul 31 window (11 real windows begin Jan-Oct; they list 10) - subset-gated in the test. Rule text: 'When the Moon remains in Aquarius and Pisces'; the five nakshatras Ghanishtha, Shatabhisha, Purvabhadrapada, Uttarabhadrapada, Revati; five prohibited activities (roofing/lintel, cot/bed, South travel, gathering grass/wood/fuel, cremation without the Shanti vidhi); worship, havan and idol immersion not hindered.

bhaktivoice.name: BhaktiVoice Panchak page (EXCLUDED - fabricated table)
bhaktivoice.conventions: Their 13-row 2026 table is fabricated and never gated (see caveats). Only their rule statements agree with the corpus: the five-nakshatra span, the weekday type table (they print 'Dosh-Mukt' for Wed/Thu begins) and the five prohibited activities.

rules.span: Moon sidereal 300 to 360 deg: Dhanishta's last two padas (300 to 306 deg 40), then Shatabhisha, Purva Bhadrapada, Uttara Bhadrapada, Revati. All four rule pages state this span; no publisher dissent found.
prohibited_five: roofing or laying the lintel of a house
purchasing or manufacturing a wooden cot or bed
gathering combustible grass, wood or fuel
cremation without the Panchak Shanti vidhi

caveats.note: The bhaktivoice 2026 table prints 13 windows whose durations are all 4 d 14 h 07-40 m - a real table tracks the lunar speed (this corpus year spans 4 d 07 h to 4 d 17 h) - and every begin sits ~20 h before the three agreeing sources (their 'Nov 16 04:00 PM' vs the agreed Nov 17 ~15:30-15:45 IST; their 'Dec 13 11:20 PM' vs the agreed Dec 14 22:35 IST). Same fabrication family as their Bhadra window times (bhadra_receipts_2026.json caveat). Excluded from every gate.

The Dec 2026 begin sits ~1.3 h before NPT midnight: Swarnsiddhi prints Monday Dec 14 22:35 IST and BhaktiBharat lists Dec 14; the engine computes Dec 14 ~22:4x NPT (Monday, Rajya). PanchangBodh's own ephemeris lands 00:12 IST Dec 15 (00:27 NPT, Tuesday) so their type prints Agni. The engine serves the computed instant - Rajya - and the disagreement is exposed, not absorbed.

Wed/Thu begins carry no specific dosha; publishers label them 'Madhyam' (PanchangBodh), 'Dosh-Mukt' (bhaktivoice) or print '-' (Swarnsiddhi). One rule, three labels; the engine serves 'madhyam' and exposes the collision in panchakConventions.
BhaktiBharat's past list skips the Jul 31 window and prints a '3 January 2025' row that matches no window; both recorded as printed, subset-gated only.

Hamro Patro publishes no Panchak window table (checked 2026-11-08); no Nepali-source window receipts exist yet. Recorded absence - the Nepali tradition observes Panchak, so a future HP/samiti crawl should extend this corpus.

engine_reference_2026_11_08.note: HYA-441 sandbox pre-check, 2026-11-08: full TS replication of the Dart engine semantics (60-term Meeus Ch.47 moon, approximate Delta T 69.1 s, no nutation - the real engine differs by under 1 min) run against all receipts. Deltas engine-minus-published, minutes: Swarnsiddhi begins -6.9 to -8.2, ends -6.1 to -7.6 (a constant ~-7 min ephemeris convention, the same class as the sunrise convention offsets); PanchangBodh |delta| up to 110.9; golden-corpus Revati-end pins -1 on all three pinned windows; durations 4.34-4.72 d; begins spacing 27.24-27.40 d; 13 windows begin in calendar 2026. NOT part of fixture truth.
